plants.name: Monstera 'Thai Constellation'
plants.tip: The cream marbling needs bright, indirect light and browns in harsh sun.

plants.name: Monstera 'Albo Variegata'
plants.tip: The white sectors scorch easily. Bright, indirect light with no direct sun.
plants.colour: White sectors on green, half-moon on some leaves

plants.name: Monstera 'Thai Sunrise'
plants.tip: Gold variegation is stronger in good light; cut back any fully green stem.

plants.name: Monstera 'Marmorata'
plants.tip: The yellow speckle holds in bright, indirect light and fades in shade.

plants.name: Monstera 'Peru'
plants.tip: The quilted leaves drink slowly — let most of the soil dry between waterings.

plants.name: Monstera 'Standleyana'
plants.tip: A self-clinging climber. Give it a moss pole and keep it out of cold drafts.
plants.colour: Glossy dark green with cream blotches

plants.name: Monstera 'Esqueleto'
plants.tip: The skeleton-like holes need bright, indirect light and a tall support to develop.

plants.name: Monstera obliqua 'Peru'
plants.tip: False obliqua — the lacy holes stay deeper in bright, indirect light.

plants.name: Monstera 'Dubia'
plants.tip: A shingle climber that scales flat surfaces; keep it humid and let the top dry out.
plants.colour: Juvenile shingled dark green with silver veining

plants.name: Monstera siltepecana
plants.tip: The silver speckle shows best on juvenile leaves in bright, indirect light.

plants.name: Monstera 'Burle Marx Flame'
plants.tip: The winding cream variegation needs strong, indirect light to stay bright.

plants.name: Monstera pinnatipartita
plants.tip: Young leaves are solid; the deep lobes come with maturity and a pole to climb.

plants.name: Monstera adansonii 'Laniata'
plants.tip: A vigorous climber. The holes stay pronounced with bright, indirect light.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Neon'
plants.tip: The lime fades to green in dim light; bright, indirect light keeps it glowing.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Njoy'
plants.tip: The white edges need bright, indirect light; direct sun browns them.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Global Green'
plants.tip: The grey mottling softens in low light; it is hardier than its looks suggest.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Pearls and Jade'
plants.tip: Marbling needs bright, indirect light; too little and the leaves go green.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Manjula'
plants.tip: Slow for a pothos. The wavy, marbled leaves scorch in direct sun.
plants.colour: Wavy leaves marbled cream and white

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Snow Queen'
plants.tip: The most white of the pothos — bright, indirect light or the colour washes out.
plants.colour: Mostly white leaves with green flecks

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Jade'
plants.tip: The plain green form is the most forgiving — happy in far dimmer corners.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Cebu Blue'
plants.tip: The blue sheen shows best in bright light; older leaves can split like a Monstera.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Skeleton Key'
plants.tip: The key-shape appears only on mature vines — let it climb rather than hanging down.
plants.colour: Key-shaped leaf with a long basal stem

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Glacier'
plants.tip: The silver edges need bright, indirect light and crisp air to stay clean.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Jessenia'
plants.tip: Like a softer Marble Queen; the yellow-green marbling needs bright light.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Harlequin'
plants.tip: The white-dominant leaves are slow to grow and easy to sunburn — bright, indirect only.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Shangri La'
plants.tip: The leaves stay crinkled and curled by nature; do not mistake it for a sick plant.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Galaxy'
plants.tip: A newer mottled pothos; keep the variegation bright with strong, indirect light.

plants.name: Epipremnum 'Albo Variegata'
plants.tip: White sectors scorch in sun and revert in shade — bright, indirect light holds them.

plants.name: Scindapsus 'Exotica'
plants.tip: The silver sheen fades in low light; bright, indirect light brings it back.

plants.name: Scindapsus 'Argyraeus'
plants.tip: Water when the top of the soil dries — it rots sooner than it droops.

plants.name: Scindapsus 'Silver Lady'
plants.tip: The heavy silver needs the brightest light you can give without direct sun.

plants.name: Scindapsus 'Treubii'
plants.tip: Grows upright before it trails. Let the top of the soil dry between waterings.

plants.name: Scindapsus 'Treubii Moonlight'
plants.tip: The silvery spears stay brightest in good indirect light.

plants.name: Scindapsus 'Jade Satin'
plants.tip: The satin finish is on the leaf, not the pot — wipe dust off so the sheen stays.

plants.name: Scindapsus 'Alba Variegata'
plants.tip: White sectors are sensitive — bright, indirect light, never hot sun.
